qAndA.answer: The narrator used mason's line to create loops on the pull-outs for attaching the poles.
qAndA.question: What material did the narrator use to create loops for attaching the poles?

qAndA.answer: He joined two carbon arrow shafts together using epoxy, creating a longer pole.

qAndA.answer: The tarp being tested is the Argon tarp.

qAndA.answer: In a previous test without pull-outs, the Argon tarp sagged significantly in the rain. The narrator added the pull-outs to improve the tent's performance under heavy rain and wind.
qAndA.question: Why was the narrator particularly interested in testing the pull-outs?

qAndA.answer: The overall mood is a mix of informative and satisfied. The narrator provides detailed explanations about the tent and modifications while expressing contentment with the results of the rain test.

youtube_description:
Finally got a rain shower to come along and give me a chance to test my pull outs and poles I added to my Argon tarp.  Worked well compared to my previous test.  Really helped keep the sides up and well supported.

My previous test without pull outs:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JOPSOfO-TSw
